properties.html:
The apartment/shop rates of the various areas in Mumbai are given in the following table along with the rate of increase in rate per annum. Refer the table and answer the questions that follow.
Mr. Jhunjhunwala wants to invest in an apartment to the maximum returns after 5 years. He has an option of investing either in Virar, Vasai or Andheri. He has in all 30 lakhs. Where should he invest to get maximum returns?

questionFeedback:
Sorry, that's not correct.
Explanation:

Mr. Jhunjhunwala has Rs.30 lakhs in all for  investment. Since the amount he invests is the same for all areas, he’ll get the maximum returns by buying property in the area with the maximum growth rate out of the available options. Thus out of Virar, Vasai and Andheri, he’ll get the maximum returns by investing in Vasai.
